title: Subpoenas served to 21 out of 24 defense witnesses—impeachment court
summary: Senate Secretary and Impeachment Clerk of Court Renato Bantug Jr. said Friday subpoenas have been served to 21 of the Defense team's 24 witnesses for the November 9–13 hearings.
